title: Fridge and Freezer Food-Safety Excursion Alert
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kitchen:appliance (appliance=fridge OR appliance=freezer)
| eval limit=if(appliance="freezer",-15,5)
| eval breach=if(temp_c>limit,1,0)
| stats sum(breach) as breach_readings, max(temp_c) as warmest by appliance
| where breach_readings>0
description: Alerts when your fridge or freezer drifts above a safe temperature, the classic sign of a left-open door or failing seal.
value: A warm fridge spoils food and risks illness; an instant excursion alert saves a freezer of food when a door is left ajar.
implementation: Put a temperature sensor in each appliance feeding `index=personal`; alert whenever a reading crosses the safe limit.
visualization: Time chart of appliance temperature with a safe-limit threshold line.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you if your fridge or freezer gets too warm, which usually means a door was left open or something is breaking.
